ncc.description: Novel Create Center 主入口：意图分类、书项目状态、续写恢复、派单与闸门记账。本窗口始终是经理。
ncc.argument_hint: [想法 | 开新书 | 续写 | 审稿 | 拆书 | continue | status]

ncc-new.description: 开一本新书：选题对标（可跳过）→ 三层递进问答 → 设定冻结（G1）→ 三级大纲冻结（G2）。停在作者确认点。

ncc-write.description: 写章循环：黄金三章（G3 验收）或日更连载。每章走 上下文包→写作→机械检查→审稿→修订→复评→落盘回写。
ncc-write.argument_hint: [第N章 | 接着写 | 黄金三章 | 今更3章]

ncc-review.description: 独立审稿与修订闭环：五域累加分制、正文证据锚点、SHA 新鲜度绑定、修订后强制复评。审稿者不产稿，修订是显式动作。
ncc-review.argument_hint: [章号或范围 | 全书 | 第3章打回重写]

ncc-deconstruct.description: 按《小说拆分总纲 5.0》拆对标书：章节索引唯一真源、逐章抽取带证据与置信级、事件溯源状态台账，产出喂给设定库与设定词典。
ncc-deconstruct.argument_hint: [原著路径或拆书库目录 | continue]

scout.description: Use this agent when picking a genre, scanning bestseller boards, or building the competitive briefing before a book starts. Produces briefing and benchmark list; never writes settings. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

worldbuilder.description: Use this agent for the world bible, power system, character cards, the setting lexicon and per-book rule/dimension tables. Owns G1 freeze evidence; never outlines plots. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

outliner.description: Use this agent for the three-level outline (master → volume → chapter), the emotion/pulse curve, and the 50-chapter rolling chapter-outline window. Owns G2 freeze evidence. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

writer.description: Use this agent to draft chapters from an assembled context pack: golden three chapters and serialized daily chapters. Must follow the pack contract and chapter craft rules; never reviews its own text. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

editor.description: Use this agent to execute explicit revisions from review observations: line-level fixes, de-AI-flavor passes, style anchor alignment. Revision is a separate act from review; must trigger re-review when body text changes. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

continuity.description: Use this agent for continuity audit: setting conflicts, timeline, foreshadow ledger obligations, state-event replay. Produces evidence-cited observations only — never edits manuscripts. Fresh context, no producer memory. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

pulse.description: Use this agent for rhythm and satisfaction review: tension peaks, emotion-point density, hook type and intensity, three-dimension pacing. Scores with body-text anchors only. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

reader.description: Use this agent as a simulated fresh reader for the golden three chapters and key chapters: would they keep reading, where do they skim, where do they drop. Blind — no outlines, no settings, no producer context. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

deconstructor.description: Use this agent to deconstruct benchmark novels per the 5.0 framework: chapter index as the single slicing source, evidence-and-confidence-tagged extraction, event-sourced state ledger. Feeds the setting vault and lexicon. Do NOT use while /ncc runs in the parent window.

checks: 力量体系含境界阶梯与量纲定义
总纲含主线与情绪曲线
黄金三章章纲含钩子设计
审稿总分 ≥ 70 且无未处置 critical
读者盲评报告已出且保留意愿明确
正文变更后已复评（SHA 一致）

iron_rules: 写这章的帽不审这章；审稿帽只产带证据的 observation，不改稿。
book.json 与 06-台账 是状态权威；markdown 投影与正文永不回写状态。
修订是显式独立动作；正文 SHA 一变，旧评审即作废，必须复评。
每章动笔前必组装并留档上下文包（context pack），无包不写。
创作决策点（G1/G2/G3）作者拍板；执行阶段（写作/审稿循环）禁停顿。
宁可记「待定/文本未明确」，不可编造设定。
审稿用累加分制：只有引用正文的准则计分，问题不扣分，覆盖率独立。
